text_en: David spoke to the Lord the words of this song on the day when the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul.
text_cn: 当上主救达味脱离了仇敌和撒乌耳的毒手时，达味向上主唱了这首诗歌，

text_en: He said: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer,
text_cn: 说“上主，我的磐石，我的保障，我的避难所；

text_en: my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold and my refuge, my savior; you save me from violence.
text_cn: 我的天主是我所依靠的磐石，是我的盾牌，我的大能救主，我的堡垒，我的藏身处。我的救主，是你救我脱离了强暴。

text_en: I call upon the Lord , who is worthy to be praised, and I am saved from my enemies.
text_cn: 我一呼求应受颂扬的上主，我便获救，脱离了我的仇敌。

text_en: For the waves of death encompassed me, the torrents of perdition assailed me;
text_cn: 死亡的波涛围绕我，凶险的急流惊吓我，

text_en: the cords of Sheol entangled me, the snares of death confronted me.
text_cn: 阴府的绳索缠住我，死亡的罗网绊着我；

text_en: In my distress I called upon the Lord ; to my God I called. From his temple he heard my voice, and my cry came to his ears.
text_cn: 在急难中我呼求上主，向我的天主呼号，他由殿中听了我的声音，我的呼声达入他的耳中。

text_en: Then the earth reeled and rocked; the foundations of the heavens trembled and quaked, because he was angry.
text_cn: 因他盛怒大作，大地震动战栗，上天的基础动荡摇撼，

text_en: Smoke went up from his nostrils, and devouring fire from his mouth; glowing coals flamed forth from him.
text_cn: 由他的鼻孔涌出浓烟，由他的口中喷出烈火，由他的身上射出火炭，

text_en: He bowed the heavens, and came down; thick darkness was under his feet.
text_cn: 使天低垂亲自降下，在他的脚下浓云密布。

text_en: He rode on a cherub, and flew; he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
text_cn: 他乘坐革鲁宾飞腾，藉着风的翼羽翱翔。

text_en: He made darkness around him a canopy, thick clouds, a gathering of water.
text_cn: 他四周以黑暗做帷幔，以豪雨浓云为帐幕。

text_en: Out of the brightness before him coals of fire flamed forth.
text_cn: 闪电在他前闪烁，红炭发出了火光。

text_en: The Lord thundered from heaven; the Most High uttered his voice.
text_cn: 上主由高天兴雷，至高者发出了呼声。

text_en: He sent out arrows, and scattered them —lightning, and routed them.
text_cn: 他射出羽箭，使敌人四散，发出闪电，使敌人惊扰。

text_en: Then the channels of the sea were seen, the foundations of the world were laid bare at the rebuke of the Lord , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.
text_cn: 上主的呵斥一发，鼻孔的怒气一出，苍海的海底即出现，大地的地基也外露。

text_en: He reached from on high, he took me, he drew me out of mighty waters.
text_cn: 他由高处伸手将我拉住，由大水中将我提出。

text_en: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
text_cn: 救我脱离了我的劲敌，摆脱了强于我的仇人。

text_en: They came upon me in the day of my calamity, but the Lord was my stay.
text_cn: 他们在我困厄之日，袭击了我，然而上主却作了我的后盾；

text_en: He brought me out into a broad place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
text_cn: 他引我步入坦途，因喜爱我而救了我。

text_en: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he recompensed me.
text_cn: 上主照我的正义酬报了我，按我双手的清白报答了我；

text_en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord , and have not wickedly departed from my God.
text_cn: 因我遵行了上主的正道，没有作恶离弃我的天主。

text_en: For all his ordinances were before me, and from his statutes I did not turn aside.
text_cn: 他的一切法令常在我前，我未曾违犯过他的诫命；

text_en: I was blameless before him, and I kept myself from guilt.
text_cn: 我在他前常保成全，自知提防各种不义。

text_en: Therefore the Lord has recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.
text_cn: 因此，上主照我的正义，照我在他眼前的纯洁，赏报了我。

text_en: With the loyal you show yourself loyal; with the blameless you show yourself blameless;
text_cn: 仁慈的人，你待他仁慈；正直的人，你待他正直；

text_en: with the pure you show yourself pure, and with the crooked you show yourself perverse.
text_cn: 纯朴的人，你待他纯朴；乖戾（lì）的人，你待他乖戾。

text_en: You deliver a humble people, but your eyes are upon the haughty to bring them down.
text_cn: 卑微的人，你必拯救；傲慢的人，你必睥（pì）视。

text_en: Indeed, you are my lamp, O Lord , the Lord lightens my darkness.
text_cn: 上主，你是我的火炬，我的天主，照明我的黑暗。

text_en: By you I can crush a troop, and by my God I can leap over a wall.
text_cn: 仗着你，我冲入了敌营；靠着我的天主，我跳过了墙垣。

text_en: This God—his way is perfect; the promise of the Lord proves true; he is a shield for all who take refuge in him.
text_cn: 天主的道路是完善的；上主的言语是纯净的；凡投奔他的人，他必作他们的后盾。

text_en: For who is God, but the Lord ? And who is a rock, except our God?
text_cn: 上主以外，还有谁是天主？除我们的天主外，还有谁是磐石？

text_en: The God who has girded me with strength has opened wide my path.
text_cn: 是天主赐我毅力，使我一路顺利，

text_en: He made my feet like the feet of deer, and set me secure on the heights.
text_cn: 使我的脚快如鹿蹄，使我屹立高地，

text_en: He trains my hands for war, so that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
text_cn: 教导我手作战，使臂膊能张开铜弓。

text_en: You have given me the shield of your salvation, and your help has made me great.
text_cn: 你把你的救生盾赐给了我，你的长甲作了我的掩护。

text_en: You have made me stride freely, and my feet do not slip;
text_cn: 你为我的脚步拓宽了路，我的脚从未颠簸。

text_en: I pursued my enemies and destroyed them, and did not turn back until they were consumed.
text_cn: 我追赶仇敌，消灭他们；不灭绝他们，决不返回。

text_en: I consumed them; I struck them down, so that they did not rise; they fell under my feet.
text_cn: 我将他们打得一蹶不振，尽都倒毙在我脚下。

text_en: For you girded me with strength for the battle; you made my assailants sink under me.
text_cn: 你赐我毅力奋勇作战，把我的对手屈服在我下，

text_en: You made my enemies turn their backs to me, those who hated me, and I destroyed them.
text_cn: 使我的敌人在我前转背而逃，使我歼灭了一切仇恨我的人。

text_en: They looked, but there was no one to save them; they cried to the Lord , but he did not answer them.
text_cn: 他们呼号，却无人施救；呼号上主，也不获应允。

text_en: I beat them fine like the dust of the earth, I crushed them and stamped them down like the mire of the streets.
text_cn: 我捣碎他们像地上的灰尘，践踏他们像道上的泥土。

text_en: You delivered me from strife with the peoples; you kept me as the head of the nations; people whom I had not known served me.
text_cn: 你由百姓的叛乱中救拔了我，立我做了列国的首领；我不认识的人民竟给我服役。

text_en: Foreigners came cringing to me; as soon as they heard of me, they obeyed me.
text_cn: 外邦的子民谄媚奉承我，一听到是我，即刻服从我；

text_en: Foreigners lost heart, and came trembling out of their strongholds.
text_cn: 外方的子民惊惶失色，战战兢兢走出自己的堡垒。

text_en: The Lord lives! Blessed be my rock, and exalted be my God, the rock of my salvation,
text_cn: 上主万岁！愿我的磐石受赞美，愿救我的天主受颂扬！

text_en: the God who gave me vengeance and brought down peoples under me,
text_cn: 天主，是你为我报了仇，使万民屈服于我，

text_en: who brought me out from my enemies; you exalted me above my adversaries, you delivered me from the violent.
text_cn: 是你救我脱离了我的仇敌，提拔我凌驾我的对手之上，救我脱免了强暴的人。

text_en: For this I will extol you, O Lord , among the nations, and sing praises to your name.
text_cn: 为此，上主！我要在异民中称谢你，歌颂你的圣名。

text_en: He is a tower of salvation for his king, and shows steadfast love to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
text_cn: 因为他使自己的君王大获胜利，对自己的受傅者达味和他的子孙，广施仁慈，直到永远。”
